name: "Qingchun Xiaoyuan Lian'ai Rizhi" Tebie Pian
source:
A story about the tales of the blooming youth! A young girl's first romance, a pure at heart "herbivore boy," a bubbly and vivacious teenage girl, and a tender but frugal childhood sweetheart. This is a story about their campus life, and how their mundane day-to-day life took a turn for the unexpected one day.

This story is a collaboration between the STORIA game production team from Taiwan, and +Hitsukirei+, and guest features popular internet voice-over artists. A comedic story of youth and love is unraveling! Content will be updated every Thursday.
